info.name: Captions & AI Ads AI Creator API

items.docs: Retrieves a list of AI creators (community avatars and AI Twins) that can be used with the AI Creator API, along with thumbnail image and video preview URLs.

Submit a video generation job using an AI Creator avatar. The script must be 800 characters or fewer and supports 30+ languages with automatic language detection. Videos max out at 1 minute. Usage is billed at 1 credit per second of generated video.
Poll the status of an AI Creator video generation job. Returns QUEUED or PROCESSING with a progress value while in-flight, or a completed video URL when done.
